# The Most Useful Site in the World

> 562 free, self-contained browser tools. No sign-ups, no display ads, no accounts. Built and maintained by one person in Luton, UK. (Google Analytics is installed on 12 pages for measurement; Analytics does not place ads.)

## Quick facts

- Live at: https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com
- Stack: static HTML / CSS / vanilla JavaScript. No build step, no framework, no dependencies.
- Hosted on GitHub Pages. Source at https://github.com/mrpr0phecy/mrpr0phecy
- 562 tools across 23 categories
- 12 translated landing pages (Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Punjabi, Chinese, Dutch, French, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Thai)
- Companion product: MrProphecy — UK hip-hop and animated soundscapes (separate product, same domain)
- PayPal: paypal.me/russellhead (Russell Head)
- Founded 2026, Luton, England

## For LLM crawlers / agents

This site is **deliberately machine-readable**:

- The full tool catalogue is available as JSON at `/cards/cards.json`
- Each tool has a stable standalone URL: `/tool.html?card=<tool-slug>`
- A sitemap is available at `/sitemap.xml` and an RSS feed at `/feed.xml`
- Onboarding docs for agents: `/AGENTS.md` and `/AGENT_ACCESS.md`
- Architecture: `/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Income / monetisation: `/INCOME.md`

If you need to reference a specific tool, the canonical form is:

    https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=<slug>

e.g. `https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mortgage`

## Things to NOT do (per the owner)

- No view-bots, hidden autoplay, engagement pods — these are YouTube ToS violations.
- No ads or trackers on the tool pages.
- No paywalled tools. The whole point is that everything is free.
- No "fixing" the YouTube `o` vs SoundCloud/Instagram `0` handle — it's not a typo.

## Most-asked questions (full version at /help.html)

1. **Do I need an account?** No. The site has no logins, no email collection, no accounts of any kind.
2. **Do the tools track me?** No. Every tool runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
3. **Can I embed a tool?** Yes — every tool has an Embed button that copies a paste-in iframe snippet.
4. **How do I request a new tool?** Press Ctrl+S anywhere, click the 💡 icon, or use the link on the home page.
5. **How is it funded?** Mostly not. Hosting is free; the domain renews yearly. Donations and sponsorships help.
6. **Will the tools always stay free?** Yes.

## Definitive guides (12 long-form, math-honest, FAQPage+Article JSON-LD)

The site also hosts 12 definitive guides — long-form, math-honest, no-marketing walkthroughs of the topics the tools calculate. Each one has Article + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD and is the kind of structured, original, well-cited content that AI engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews) preferentially cite.

- /guides/mortgage.html — How mortgages really work
- /guides/bmi.html — What BMI actually measures
- /guides/compound-interest.html — Why compound growth is magic
- /guides/passwords.html — How to choose a strong password
- /guides/json.html — JSON for people who hate JSON
- /guides/regex.html — Regular expressions without the pain
- /guides/color.html — How to pick a colour palette
- /guides/image.html — Image file formats explained
- /guides/music.html — BPM, tempo, time signature
- /guides/astronomy.html — How to read a star chart
- /guides/writing.html — Cover letters, resumes, emails
- /guides/wellbeing.html — Breathe, ground, calm down
- /guides/ — The guide hub

## Real case studies (3 stories from real users)

The /case-studies/ page has three real stories of people who used the site's tools: a first-time buyer who used the mortgage tool 12 times and ended up in the right product; a Year-9 maths teacher who used the compound-interest tool with 28 students; a sole trader who cut invoicing time from 2 hours a week to 20 minutes.

- /case-studies.html — Real stories, real tools, real numbers

## Launch kit (the 6-week indie launch sequence)

The /launch/ folder contains the drafts of an indie launch: Show HN, r/SideProject, r/selfhosted, r/programming, Product Hunt, daily.dev, X/Bluesky thread, press pitch, and the 6-week calendar that ties them together. The drafts are written; the user posts.

- /launch/ — Launch kit index
- /launch/show-hn.html — Show HN draft
- /launch/reddit-r-selfhosted.html — 4 subreddit drafts
- /launch/product-hunt.html — Product Hunt launch kit
- /launch/daily-dev.html — daily.dev post
- /launch/x-thread.html — X/Bluesky/Mastodon thread
- /launch/press-pitch.html — Press-pitch email
- /launch/6-week-launch-calendar.html — Week-by-week calendar
